C1481.title: Online Takedown Orders in the Amitabh Bachchan Personality-Rights Case
C1481.summary: On November 25, 2022, the Delhi High Court supplemented its interim injunction in Amitabh Bachchan's personality-rights suit with online enforcement orders. It directed telecommunications and information-technology authorities to have internet providers block listed infringing links and required domain registrars to disclose registrant details. The orders addressed websites, applications, and merchandise operations using his name, voice, and likeness.
